description: This PHP class 'ListViewColumnsParams' extends 'BaseParam' and is part of the 'Api\V8\Param' namespace. It provides methods to retrieve module name parameters and configure options for list view column parameters in a SuiteCRM API context.

classes.name: ListViewColumnsParams
classes.description: A parameter class used for handling list view column parameters within the SuiteCRM API, enabling configuration of options and retrieval of module names.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the module name from the parameters array.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Sets up the options resolver with the options specified for list view columns, particularly the module name parameter.
